p_copy.about: Kein Klub, aionia's monthly residency at H0l0 in Ridgewood, Queens, returns on Friday, December 11 with Marie Davidson and Danny Daze playing back to back for the first time. The night runs from 10 PM to 6 AM across two rooms, built from three four-hour sets.
p_copy.expect: A two-room club night of long sets rather than a quick rotation of names, from a series that leans toward discovery and raw, unusual club music. The promoter asks for no phones on the dance floor, says consent is mandatory and harassment and discrimination are not tolerated, and notes that its team sometimes takes anonymous wide shots but never photographs faces. My take: this is for people who want adventurous, left-field club music on a dance floor without phones, deep into the morning.
p_copy.music: Room 1 opens with Jon K from 10 PM to 2 AM, then Marie Davidson b2b Danny Daze from 2 AM to 6 AM. Room 2 has Kilopatrah Jones from midnight to 4 AM, playing house and disco. Per the listing, Marie Davidson works across techno, electro, italo and spoken word; Danny Daze draws on Miami bass, Detroit techno and Dutch electro and runs the label Omnidisc; Jon K, a co-founder of MAL Recordings with a long run on NTS, moves through jungle, UK garage, house and dub; Kilopatrah Jones is Queens-born, a Nowadays resident and a regular on The Lot Radio.
p_copy.before_you_go: DICE lists 10 PM to 6 AM. It is 21+, so bring a government photo ID.
